title: Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi (Theme 8: Ndege wa porini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child changes the verb end to show done for someone (-ewa/-iwa), can be done (-eka/-ika) or done to each other (-ana).
representations: pictures: a gift given to a child, a bird seen easily, friends greeting each other
steps: Ask: done for, can be done, or to each other?
Choose the ending by the stem vowel.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "wanasalimiana" and one sentence with the -eka form.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kikombe kilianguka na ___." Kwa nini "kilivunjiwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kutendeka huonyesha kitu kinaweza kutendwa au kinatendeka chenyewe, kama kuvunjika. Kutendewa huonyesha kitendo kimefanyiwa mtu, kama kupikiwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Marafiki wawili ___ kila asubuhi." Kwa nini "wanasalimu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kutendana huonyesha watu wawili au zaidi wanafanyiana kitendo kimoja: kusalimiana, kupendana, kusaidiana.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mama alimpikia mtoto uji. Mtoto ___ uji na mama." Kwa nini "alipika" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Hapa kitenzi lazima kibadilike kwa kiambishi ili kuonyesha kinachotokea: mama alipikiwa chakula.

misconceptions.ask: Irabu ya mwisho ya mzizi ni ipi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi chenye o au e kwenye mzizi huchukua -eka: someka.
